title.en: Taipei parks, squares and green spaces
title.zh: 臺北市公園、廣場與綠地

description.en: Official park reference locations and source-reported areas from Taipei's Parks and Street Lights Office.
description.zh: 臺北市公園路燈工程管理處發布的公園定位點與來源面積。

limitation.en: Taipei City only. These are park reference points, not park boundary polygons. Source area values are not national green-cover estimates; records outside the official city boundary are excluded.
limitation.zh: 僅涵蓋臺北市；資料為公園定位點而非公園邊界。來源面積不代表全國綠覆率；不符官方市界的點位排除。

description.en: Individually identified public park trees with reported species, survey dates and dimensions.
description.zh: 保留原始樹籍編號、樹種、調查日期與尺寸之公園樹木紀錄。

limitation.en: Taipei public parks only, not all city trees or national tree coverage. Survey-date charts describe inventory records, not planting, survival or canopy change. Invalid spreadsheet dates remain missing. The city reports ongoing platform updates; check the source for removals and relocations.
limitation.zh: 僅臺北市公園，非全市或全國樹木完整覆蓋。調查日期圖表呈現盤點紀錄，不代表栽植、存活或樹冠變遷；無效試算表日期維持缺值。市府正更新平台，移除及移植情形以來源為準。

description.en: A historical, one-time municipal survey of trees in selected Taipei riverside parks and embankments.
description.zh: 臺北市部分河濱公園及堤外灘地之一次性歷史喬木調查。

limitation.en: One-time 2016–2017 survey; the source explicitly states there are no subsequent inventory updates. Covers selected Taipei riverside parks, not nationwide trees. Original identifiers are preserved and duplicate source IDs are removed.
limitation.zh: 2016–2017 年一次性調查；來源明確說明結案後未再更新，非現況存活清冊。僅部分臺北市河濱公園，不代表全國；保留原始編號並排除重複編號。

title.en: Official Taipei tree inventory update notice
title.zh: 臺北市樹籍平台更新說明

description.en: The city explains the ongoing reconciliation of tree removals and relocations. A catalogue record does not prove the tree is currently present.
description.zh: 市府說明樹木移除、移植與平台更新作業；盤點紀錄不等於該樹目前仍存在。

description.en: Official satellite surface-temperature documentation. No validated Taiwan scene has been imported; this is distinct from the measured station air-temperature layer.
description.zh: 官方衛星地表溫度說明；尚未匯入經驗證之臺灣影像，與測站實測氣溫圖層不同。
